subject: Enquiry about sampling design vs. analysis

messages.author: 072fd9573fd81bbc
messages.subject: Enquiry about sampling design vs. analysis
parts:
Hello,

I have recently conducted line transects on desert as my  study area having highly undulating plains and dunes.
My transects were grids based and while assessing the sightings using perpendicular distance method for density estimation for various mammals, my sampling design was NOT created using Distance software but otherwise.

Now, I want to estimate density using Distance software. 

So, my question is that if my sampling design is NOT created using this software, still can I proceed for analysis using this software when I have all the proper data??

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Enquiry about sampling design vs. analysis
parts:
Vigil

You can certainly analyse the data you have collected using program Distance.  There is no necessity of using the design engine to create your survey to analyse your data with this software.  The design "engine" and the analysis "engines" work independently of one another, except when conducting simulations.

You'll be fine analysing your data in Distance.
